Your first month is on results.

If you've got 1,000 or more opted-in contacts across your newsletter, bookings and online orders, I'll set up the welcome email and send these campaigns, plus one more, to that list in the lead-up to Christmas. I owned my own cafés for close to a decade. Business owner to business owner, I wouldn't put this forward if I didn't think it would pay for itself.

*How it's measured: every email gets its own tracked links, plus a code just for these emails where it fits (an order, voucher or booking code).
